title: Integration
description: An integration writes entities into the catalog: a connector brings in data, pushed by another system or pulled on a schedule, and mappings turn it into entities of blueprints with jq.

metadata.description: What identifies the integration. Its icon and color come from its connector, so it takes neither.

mappings.description: One mapping for each kind of entity the integration writes. They're also the only blueprints it can write.

type.description: push: other systems send JSON to the ingest API with an ingestion token. portal: the portal's own users, groups, blueprints and integrations, synced one way. http: JSON fetched from URLs on a schedule, following pages.

httpConfig.description: The http connector's config. Only it takes one.

resources.description: The JSON documents to fetch, keyed by the resource name mappings use.

url.description: The http or https URL of the first page.

next.description: jq over a page giving the next page's URL, absolute or relative to the page, or null on the last page. Left out, there's one page.

headers.description: Request headers, keyed by name. Write secrets as {env: GP_SECRET_...}, read from the server's environment, never inline.

env.description: An environment variable of the server, starting with GP_SECRET_.

sync.description: Pull connectors only: how often to sync. Push integrations don't sync.

interval.description: A Go duration of at least 1m, such as 5m or 1h. Defaults to 15m.

mapping.description: Turns items of the incoming data into entities of one blueprint. Every expression is jq.

resource.description: Pull connectors only, and required there: what to fetch for this mapping, one of the connector's resources (portal: users, groups, blueprints or integrations; http: a key of config.resources).

blueprint.description: The blueprint whose entities it writes.

items.description: jq picking the items from the data, the pushed body or each fetched page, such as .services[]. Each result is one entity. Defaults to ., the data itself.

filter.description: jq over each item; keeps the items it's true for.

entityMapping.description: Makes an entity from an item, with jq over the item.

identifier.description: jq giving the entity's identifier, such as .id.

title.description: jq giving the entity's title. Defaults to its identifier.

properties.description: jq giving each property's value, keyed by the blueprint's stored property or relation. A relation takes the identifier, or a list of them, of the related entities.
